title: RAW complete-unit semantic demand across whole, compressed, inflected and multivalent encodings
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. A fixed form that always carries concept C requires C in every complete semantic unit containing that form, even when the form abbreviates a construction or has inflected relatives. Compare this necessary incidence demand with prospectively defined complete-source concept footprints; explicitly show how much multivalence or unit/genre mismatch would be needed to retain a narrow meaning. No source counts, target extraction or probability model has been run.

design.mechanism: Use semantic presence in complete discourse units rather than equality of source-word and Voynich-group counts. A universally concept-bearing form implies unit-level concept presence. Inflection, internal abbreviation and packing do not remove that implication when each use still carries the concept. A finite multivalent interpretation instead owes an explicit account of the units where the form has another meaning. This exposes the semantic demand of a gloss without assuming that one Voynich group equals one plaintext word.
design.unit: A separately registered complete-unit population. Candidate source native paragraphs/sections and Voynich source-marked complete paragraphs are only proposed units, not established equivalents. No unit mapping is selected here. A future registration must choose exact source and target boundary layers, inclusion rules and any bounded adjacent-unit coarsenings before inspecting concept counts or extracting target incidence.
design.contrast: A narrow obligatory concept such as WINTER or WATER in every use; a compressed construction that obligatorily contains that same concept; an inflectional family whose every licensed form retains it; and a multivalent or parameterized construction where only an explicitly qualified subset carries it. These are distinct claims, not interchangeable explanations after counting.
design.prediction: If source-informed unit incidence remains much lower than the necessary incidence of a proposed obligatory concept-bearing form under every retained unit/genre bridge, the fixed obligatory-gloss model pays an explicit mismatch or fails that conditional bridge. Compression alone cannot repair it. If a multivalent model can survive only by making many form-bearing units concept-free, the candidate changes from a portable lexical gloss to a conditional-sense/construction account whose scope must be written. If a plausible registered bridge or source uncertainty removes the contrast, frequency provides no selection.
design.scope: Source-only design until a qualified complete-work roster, endpoint annotation and unit/genre bridges are independently fixed. This is a new raw descendant, not reopening or repairing IDEA607. The separately authorized source-roster acquisition is availability work, not a semantic frequency result. No Voynich source, reserve or image is opened by this proposal.

definitions: For one fixed complete-unit population U, A is the set of units containing at least one exact occurrence of the prospectively nominated form or finite family.
C is the set of units that express the nominated semantic concept under the registered explicit/scope convention, independently of spelling or number of groups.
p = |A|/|U|. An obligatory-C interpretation requires A to be a subset of C, so the required concept incidence is at least p.
If a separately justified bridge stipulates |C|/|U| <= q, then |A outside C|/|A| >= max(0, 1 - q/p), for p>0. This is a deterministic conditional bound, not a posterior probability.
The bound concerns form-bearing units without C. It is not the proportion of all form tokens having another sense; uneven token counts per unit prevent that conversion.
logical_core.source_link: The observed maximum concept incidence in three books is not automatically a bound q for Voynich. Report the required incidence p beside every complete-source footprint and any explicitly assumed q range. A target implication is available only within a separately justified source-to-target unit/genre bridge; otherwise retain a source comparison and a demand statement, with no rejection or calibrated probability.
logical_core.interval_rule: Uncertain annotation, reader disagreement and incomplete source boundaries remain explicit intervals or missing capacity. Any future robust incompatibility must survive the registered interval treatment, including the most permissive retained q and least demanding eligible p. RF without native paragraph marks cannot borrow ZL boundaries as an independent reading.

encoding_rivals.contract: Each occurrence of the exact whole form denotes or explicitly introduces C in its own registered unit. Additional source synonyms are allowed; the target form need not express every source mention. A subset requirement rather than equal counts follows.
encoding_rivals.consequence: Concept incidence must be at least form-bearing-unit incidence. No source-token/group equality is assumed.

encoding_rivals.contract: The group expresses a larger phrase/event description whose semantics obligatorily includes C, for example a seasonal instruction containing WINTER. Arbitrarily many other words or concepts may be packed inside that same unit; no cross-unit reference or dropped-C branch is supplied for free.
encoding_rivals.consequence: The same incidence requirement holds. A generic constructor such as APPLY(x), whose argument is only sometimes winter-related, is a different multivalent/parameterized claim and does not inherit a WINTER gloss.

encoding_rivals.contract: A finite independently nominated set of complete forms shares C despite inflection or contextual surface choice. Family membership is a paid hypothesis; substring resemblance and the productive formal baseline do not establish it.
encoding_rivals.consequence: Use the union of all member-bearing units, avoiding double counting. Allomorph splitting cannot lower the necessary concept demand already supplied by one member. A prefix with a different semantic effect cannot be merged merely to change frequency.

encoding_rivals.contract: The same written form may have several senses or a typed argument that changes its content. Before comparison, disclose either fixed conditioning rules or a finite permitted unit-level escape budget. Unrestricted per-occurrence choices are retained as a non-discriminating rival rather than rejected.
encoding_rivals.consequence: The bound states the minimum share of form-bearing units that would need to be concept-free under a given q. If that exceeds the registered budget, only that constrained rival fails. With unrestricted multivalence or cross-unit abbreviation, incidence alone supplies no meaning preference.

prospective_source_endpoints.rule: The old fixed eight-concept list remains visible as motivation, not a new authorization to count it. Before source body/count access, a separate endpoint note must define concepts, expressed versus inferred content, metalinguistic uses, anaphora, headings and scope propagation, function realizations, uncertain cases and full-work boundaries. It must explain whether BODY/PERSON is one union concept and keep implicit grammar distinct from explicit realization. No favorable source spelling list or boundary layer may be chosen after counts.

paid_assumptions: At least one registered unit/genre bridge is substantively plausible for the manuscript. A source paragraph is not automatically a Voynich paragraph, and physical leaves are not equal-content units.

Obligatory-C occurrences contribute C inside their own unit; references to a remote heading, inherited topic, copied exemplars, decorative/null writing or long-range abbreviation require separate scope rules.
Semantic annotations are complete enough to distinguish expressed concept presence from source-language surface counts. Source translations, register and genre can change what is explicit.
A hypothesized finite family has its declared shared meaning; formal composability alone does not supply that meaning or family identity.
Any bound q or mixture/coarsening range is justified and fixed before seeing the comparison, rather than defined as the observed source maximum and called a universal law.
decision_outcomes: STABLE_CONDITIONAL_DEMAND_CONFLICT: down-prioritize the obligatory narrow gloss within the retained bridges; keep the required multivalence/scope burden and all alternative models explicit.
SOURCE_OR_ENCODING_SENSITIVE: at least one retained bridge, uncertain annotation or encoding rival removes the distinction; frequency does not select a meaning, and no larger classifier follows.
NO_SOURCE_SEPARATION: named concept footprints overlap sufficiently that no useful demand contrast arises; retain all semantic candidates.
NO_UNIT_OR_GENRE_BRIDGE: useful complete-source descriptions may exist, but no target constraint follows. Do not turn source availability into semantic evidence.
MISSING_COMPLETE_ENDPOINTS: stop before counting; do not substitute keyword occurrence counts for concept incidence.

predecessors.retained: Cached three-independent-work feasibility failed; new source acquisition is separate and does not itself reopen607.
predecessors.difference: The earlier raw paid one-whole/one-sense and unspecified expression granularity. This proposal states a unit-incidence necessary condition that survives within-unit compression/inflection and explicitly quantifies the unit-level multivalent escape requirement. It does not reuse or score the failed intake.

predecessors.retained: No robust identity-free functional detector transferred; the later global role classifier had23TP/42FP/60FN. No role, POS or probability is inherited.
predecessors.difference: This is a disclosed semantic obligation of an explicitly named hypothesis, not an attempt to name a class from a local distributional signature.

predecessors.retained: Formal scores preserve1,658,880 semantic renamings; generic comparator topology did not transfer. A positive structural diagnostic cannot name a semantic class.
predecessors.difference: Only an independently annotated named source endpoint plus an explicit unit/genre bridge could break a demand symmetry. Without it the renaming ambiguity remains.

predecessors.retained: The fixed ordered plant-name model and both exact joint bath count models retain their original contradictions and unknowns. No relaxed source mapping or new carrier dictionary repairs them.
predecessors.difference: No direct source-copy claim, exact count equality, paragraph matching search or lexicon fitting is proposed. The new object is a conditional demand envelope across independent complete works and declared encoding rivals.

predecessors.retained: Historical mixed whole/field architectures exist; the24 head-meaning permutations are not selected by source vocabulary frequency. No EVA-letter initialism or head meaning is inherited.

design.smallest_next_step: If selected after roster acquisition, write one bounded endpoint/unit-bridge decision before any source concept counts or target incidence extraction. First decide whether the available source units can support the stated semantic obligation at all. This RAW authoring is not that registration, not implementation approval and not a new tracking tool.
design.claim_ceiling: An explicit conditional burden on a proposed meaning, not a confirmed word, POS, semantic likelihood, source identification or independent manuscript confirmation. No significance claim without an appropriate whole-search countercontrol.
design.access_receipt: Producer read only route/decision/review documents, bounded registry cards and cited primary reports. No newly acquired complete-source body, concept count, target row, target image or reserve was inspected for this proposal. Historical reported counts remain predecessor evidence only.
